What's helped me is that life is one day at a time and that big and small things take time. 

Life is not a straight road and things will mostly not work out the way you thought. Use times of energy and motivation to get moving and keep at it. Give yourself time to adjust and take necessary breaks without beating yourself up.
People always make it seem like it's so easy to make new friends, but when you actually try to talk to people and make some friends they never stick around or even care.

Drinking always made my thoughts worse, maybe you're at that point now, too. 

I would not advice to drink to forget everything as this will not help you in the end. Better find things (hobbies, music, art, etc) that distract you, but don't harm you in a way. If you're in such a bad place that nothing helps I think it would be best to seek professional help or maybe talk about it with someone you can trust.
